9.issue_summary: The app requests the restricted 'android.permission.USE_EXACT_ALARM' permission in AndroidManifest.xml, but as a productivity task and routine planner, it does not qualify for this permission under Google Play policy.
9.evidence: app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml line 6 declares <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.USE_EXACT_ALARM" /> alongside SCHEDULE_EXACT_ALARM. The app is a task/routine planner (com.dalgeer.lifeplanner) using exact alarms for task and routine reminders in AlarmScheduler.kt.
9.recommendation: Remove <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.USE_EXACT_ALARM" /> from app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml. Rely instead on android.permission.SCHEDULE_EXACT_ALARM with runtime checks using PermissionUtils.canScheduleExactAlarms().
